authorization: POST-HOC evaluation on previously-read frozen partitions (BCN guarded test, HAM E3 test side, HAM sealed partition), explicitly authorized by the user. The original registered evaluations (bcn_test_evaluation.json, ham_evaluation.json, sealed_v2_evaluation.json) remain the confirmatory results and are reproduced here as candidate (a) wiring self-checks, not replaced. All hyperparameters (C, operating points) are selected on train / valid / train-side OOF only; the test partitions are scored, never selected on.

levers: per-class SK/MISC operating point selected on train/valid only
recipe_under_test.not_transferred: clinic view (does not exist for HAM/BCN); TTA features (not cached for HAM/BCN and not part of the promoted diagnosis recipe -- TTA entered only the Derm7pt criteria heads, which have no HAM/BCN labels); criteria heads (no HAM/BCN criterion annotations).

bcn.partition: bcn20000 lesion-level test (guarded split, POST-HOC re-read)

candidate_a_visual_plus_op.config: dermlip lesion-pooled (512-d), UNBALANCED LR C=10.0 (train-CV), + operating point

operating_point_selection.rule: argmax(posterior / per_class_weight); weight<1 boosts that class's rank. Grid-searched w_SK, w_MISC independently over {1.0,0.7,0.5,0.35,0.25,0.15} on the selection split (posterior re-ranking only, no refitting). Chosen = max(recall_SK + recall_MISC) subject to balanced_accuracy staying within 0.02 of the unweighted argmax. Mirrors scripts/dev/derm7pt_p1_sweep.py exactly.
